name: Apollo 10 CSM
about: Apollo 10 CSM (1969-043A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1969 May 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1969 May 18), held fixed
docked to S03949; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
